lead: Gautam Gambhir is a widely followed Indian cricketer, born on 14 October 1981 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 44 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has represented Kolkata Knight Riders and India national cricket team and has held the office of Member of the 17th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Gautam facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
